name: biomedical-waste-tracking
description: Smart Biomedical Waste Tracking System — traceability from generation to disposal

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/api && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
